newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends off highs after buyers retreat.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends off highs after buyers retreat.

text.p: LIFFE robusta coffee futures ended off the day's highs on Tuesday after an early rally discouraged industry buyers, traders said.
Front-month January last traded at $1,339, up $2, having come down from a day's high of $1,350, in volume of 1,396 lots.
March, the most active contract, last traded up $5 at $1,293 in volume of 1,699 lots, having reached a day's high of $1,305.
Total volume was 4,813 lots, which traders described as "modest".
"Expect selling into any decent rally," one said, adding that buyers' eagerness to come in had diminished as prices rose and the weak tone could continue.
Fund selling, which had held prices down Monday and last week abated triggering a rise amid healthy industry buying early in the day.
Traders described the day's business as a "healthy two-way trade" between origin sellers and the industry.
